invariants.rationale: A new HoodieWriteMetadata is constructed and always returned, so result should not be null.
setWriteStatuses is always called with a HoodieListData.eager instance.
clusteringPlan is dereferenced (e.g., clusteringPlan.getInputGroups()) with no preceding null check.
schema is provided as a parameter and likely required for correct clustering, though not directly dereferenced.
instantTime is passed through to runClusteringForGroup and must not be null.
